sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 260. Magic damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 3 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 7500
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 7500
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the max HP of all allies by 100% for 60 seconds.
